caseName: Rowley v. Chicago & Northwestern Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Rowley, Treasurer v. Chicago & Northwestern Railway Co.

opinions.text: Ordered that in this cause the opinion announced November 5, 1934 be and hereby it is amended by inserting at the end and *533before the words “ Decree reversed ” these words: “ The district court may cause to be corrected the error in calculation referred to in marginal note 2.” Opinion reported as amended, ante, p. 102.
